Sect: @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat}

Hailing from Eastern Europe, the Tzimisce are an ancient and inhuman clan who study mortals and vampires alike with cold, clinical detachment, reshaping flesh through their unique mastery of Vicissitude. Many trace their founding philosophy to the very birth of the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat} sect, which the clan dominates.

Disciplines: Animalism, Auspex, Vicissitude

Advantage: All Tzimisce start with one free Occult Ability Trait, and may learn the first two levels of any Lore Ability with ease (Storyteller discretion).

Disadvantage: A Tzimisce must sleep surrounded by at least two handfuls of soil from their grave or native homeland. Each day without such rest they suffer a one-Trait penalty on all challenges, removed one-for-one after resting with the proper earth.

Organization: Deeply tied to @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat} leadership and ritual tradition; notable sub-groups include the Bratovich family and practitioners of koldunic sorcery.

See also: @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{the Sabbat}, which Tzimisce co-founded alongside the Anarch Revolt that shattered the old order.
